Yes, we do! We have the Soylent Rewards program, which is designed to be simple and rewarding:

Program Overview:
Shop and engage with Soylent.
Earn credits.
Get rewarded!
How to Earn Credits:

You can earn credits through the following activities:

Refer a friend: Get a $15 credit when you refer a friend. Your friend also receives a $15 discount, and we donate 10 meals to our food bank partners. To refer a friend, log into your account to find your unique referral link. Your friend must spend over $30 and be a new customer for the referral to be successful. You can refer up to 5 friends.
Credits on eligible purchases: Earn 3% back in credits on your eligible purchases.
How to Use Your Credits:

Credits can be used to pay for upcoming subscription or one-time orders:

For one-time orders: You can apply your credits directly on the checkout page.
For existing subscriptions: Go to the "View your next order" page and toggle on the option to auto-apply your credits to your next order.
Important Rules & Restrictions:
Credits will expire 12 months after they are earned.
Credits cannot be returned or reversed once a reward has been claimed.
Rewarded promotions or codes cannot be combined (limit 1 promo per transaction).
Accruals and balances can take up to 14 days for approval or refresh.
Checking Your Credit Balance:

You can check your available credits and credit activity by logging into your account, clicking "Manage subscriptions" (even if you're not a subscriber), then "Address & payment details," and finally "Manage payment methods."

Please note that points earned from past programs before April 2024 have already expired and will not be transferred. Points earned since April 2024 will be transitioned into credits.

You can learn more about the Soylent Rewards program here: Loyalty & Discount Programs and Soylent Rewards.
